purpose: Repair discard advice selection and hand-limit wording, preserve drafts after rejected End Play commands, and refresh a retained guide fixture.
changes: RecommendDiscard ranks only physical owner Hand entities published by the current PendingDecision.ValidCardIds. Existing keep-value ranking, Peach preference, stable Id order and count are retained.
ActionHint and CurrentGuideBody share the current native discard Prompt plus selected count; HP is no longer presented as the evaluated hand limit.
EndTurn submits before clearing its local draft and clears only after Accepted. All prior successful-path reset fields remain.
The retained table-shortcut check now covers actual tutorial EndTurnButton.OnClick and Ctrl+Enter rejection followed by one exact original Slash submission.
One focused discard UI check and one routine filter are added; no old pruned registrations are restored.
The retained guide test uses fixed seed 721019 with the existing Lord fixture, real preview and confirmation, native human Play prerequisites, player-safe snapshots and finally-based Window cleanup.

boundaries: The discard fixture issues actual grantTurnHandLimitCardKindExemption through UseProgramSkillCommand, reaches the native discard prompt through real commands and restores an actual manual checkpoint before operating WPF.
Recommendation preserves all four player-safe views, accepted-command count and card-movement count; Cancel and repeat recommendation remain drafts.

The available real confirmation button submits one exact DiscardCardsCommand, one HandLimitDiscardedEvent and one Hand-to-Discard movement for each eligible entity; all exempt entities stay in owner Hand.
Cold checkpoint restore agrees for all four private player-safe snapshots.

Both tutorial rejection entry paths preserve engine identity, revision, all five player-safe views, serialized accepted commands and movements, event count, actual Card/Seat references and the enabled original confirmation button; fresh Enter submits the original Slash exactly once and tutorial exit restores the original table.
